threshold_binding_rule: Every numeric threshold/tolerance must be frozen from Gate 1-3 outputs and hash-bound in the Gate 4 observation registration before start; this register selects none.

signals.subject: service process, heartbeat, bounded restart count and quarantine state
signals.required_record: monitoring sample plus incident when threshold triggers

signals.subject: execution-off state and static capability fingerprint
signals.required_record: every startup and identity change; any defect latches quarantine

signals.subject: account, symbol, terminal build, application and configuration identity
quote/bar freshness, gaps and completed-bar timing
signals.required_record: every eligible decision instant and anomaly

signals.subject: session, holiday, Event Guard, shock health and source disagreements
signals.severity_source: frozen typed states plus future source thresholds

signals.subject: journal/audit continuity, write latency, disk capacity, backup age and off-host copy state
signals.required_record: continuous health and immutable recovery evidence

signals.subject: expected, observed, duplicate and unexplained missing decision instants
replay/live feature and setup mismatches
signals.required_record: paired fixture hashes and mismatch inventory

signals.subject: transport, schema and freshness failures if separately authorized
alert path health under accepted A1 contract
signals.required_record: shadow-period delivery-path health; G0-09 canary is not an SLA

signals.subject: open, contained and resolved incident counts by frozen severity
signals.required_record: append-only incident register and acceptance inventory

pre_start_dependencies: Gate 1 PASS receipt and release manifest
Gate 2 PASS receipt bound to the same release
Gate 3 PASS receipt bound to the same release/data/registration
Gate 4 observation registration with hash-bound thresholds, tolerances, duration, coverage and extension rule
claim_limit: Monitoring inventory preparation only. It selects no threshold, starts no observation, calls no external service and grants no Gate 4 or trading credit.
